name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – § 17 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 17.Expresses deep concern about the mounting debt burden facing many African countries; calls for the EU and other relevant partners to support a reform of the global financial architecture to ensure fairer terms and transparency; adds that these reforms should not relieve African states of their responsibility, as they are primarily responsible for the sound management of their public finances;
